youtube.title: Why Power Lines Have Giant Orange Balls 🟠 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The large orange spheres on some power lines are aircraft warning markers. Thin cables are very hard to see from the air, especially against hills or sky, so markers are added where lines cross valleys, rivers and areas near airports or low-flying routes. Their bright color and size make the line visible to pilots in time to avoid it.
